agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the Epaphras sentence, "BELOVED, baker.", and the price-sticker sentence. Non-opening story cards are limited to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The card explicitly retells Colossians 1:6 when it says the gospel was bearing fruit and growing, as well as telling Colossians 1:10. Its citation of only Colossians 1:10 does not cover everything the card tells.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: The right answer, "Giving thanks to the Father," is in Colossians 1:12. Including Colossians 1:11 also cites the setup about strength, patience and joyfully, making the choice-card citation wider than the verse of its right answer.

rule.text: A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer.

agent.problem: The walkthrough never teaches the key positive fact of Colossians 1:12: the Father has qualified the Colossians to share in the inheritance. Card 9 only says they get a share, and marking this statement False merely denies self-qualification without ever identifying the Father's qualifying action.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
